description: Answer 'when did this flow last run, and did it work?': the run history of one cloud flow, most recent first, with status, start and end time, duration and the error of a failed run. Read-only. Use it to find the run you care about, then cs_explain_flow_run on that run to learn why it failed. Uses the Power Automate service, which is a separate sign-in from Dataverse (cs_login scope 'flow'). Unverified against a live tenant.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_list_flow_runs
title: List flow runs
